items.title: Light Novel 'Isekai Douraku ni Akitara' Gets TV Anime in Winter 2027
items.summary: Publishing company Shufunotomo announced a television anime adaptation of Fudaya Sanmongarasu and Tomozo's Isekai Douraku ni Akitara (Living It Up in Another World Until I Get Bored) light novel on Friday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027. Sanmongarasu began writing the adventure fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in June 2016. Shufunotomo began printing the light novel under its Prime Novels imprint in June 2017, featuring illustrations by Tomozo. The imprint published two volumes, with the second volume released in April 2018. The series was later republished under the Hero Bunko imprint by Imagica Infos in January 2019. The seventh volume was published in October 2024. The eighth volume is scheduled for release on November 30, with its wraparound band featuring the anime announcement (pictured). SAA began drawing a manga adaptation of the series on the Hero Comics web service in June 2025. The first volume was released digitally on September 30. Hanashi Media licensed the light novel for English release under the title Living It Up in Another World Until I Get Bored, with the first volume scheduled for release on May 9, 2027. On his way home, he suddenly finds himself stranded in another world-a strange, game-like place governed by levels, magic, skills, and other fantastical rules. LiSA , de son vrai nom Risa Oribe , est une chanteuse japonaise née le 24 juin dans la préfecture de Gifu, au Japon. Elle commence à se faire connaître en 2010 grâce à l’anime Angel Beats!, dans lequel elle prête sa voix chantée au personnage de Yui , membre du groupe fictif Girls Dead Monster. En 2011, elle lance sa carrière solo avec le mini-album Letters to U . Elle gagne ensuite en popularité en interprétant des chansons pour des animes célèbres, notamment Fate/Zero avec oath sign et Sword Art Online avec crossing field . Grâce à sa voix puissante, son énergie et son style mêlant rock et pop japonaise, elle devient rapidement une artiste incontournable dans le milieu de l’ anisong. La carrière de LiSA connaît un immense succès en 2019 avec Gurenge , le générique d’ouverture de l’anime Demon Slayer , qui va conquérir un large public tant au Japon qu’à l’international. items.title: Supporting Cast Pair for 'Shin Oishinbo' Announced
items.summary: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tetsu Kariya's Oishinbo manga, titled Shin Oishinbo, announced a supporting pair of cast on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027. Voice actors Kenji Yamauchi (Toujima Tanzaburou wa Kamen Rider ni Naritai) and Ken Uo (Nazotoki wa Dinner no Ato de) are joining the anime as Mantarou Kyougoku and Toujin Touyama, respectively. Kenichi Nishida (Sayounara Ryuusei, Konnichiwa Jinsei) is directing the anime at SynergySP and Vega Entertainment. Takahiro Nagano (Tensei shitara Ken deshita) is handling the series composition, while Nozomi Kawashige (Deatte 5-byou de Battle) is designing the characters. Kariya began writing Oishinbo in Shogakukan's Big Comic Spirits magazine in 1983, featuring art by Akira Hanasaki. Shogakukan published the 111th and latest volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since May 2014. VIZ Media licensed the manga in English and published seven themed compilation volumes under its VIZ Signature imprint from January 2009 to January 2010. Shin-Ei Animation produced a television anime based on the manga that ran for 136 episodes from October 1988 to March 1992. Source: Official Site

The story combines the romantic pursuits of the protagonists, Taiki and Chinatsu, with the passion of spokon , and the adventure of growing up from adolescence. While the Blue Box manga officially ended on July 13 , we can still follow our favorite characters in the anime adaptation currently airing. Blue Box Season 2 explores new sides of the cast and introduces the long awaited Yumeka Goto, a person from Chinatsu’s past. Kadokawa published the fifth volume in October 2024. A spin-off series titled Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara Transit featuring Hirota Takahara, began serializing on March 20. items.summary: Fans of anime and Japanese music are in for a treat this December, as the Music Way Project brings three much-loved live acts to London for a one-off triple headliner event called matsuri ’26: Japanese Music Experience LONDON . British fans can look forward to a fantastic evening show from hitsujibungaku, Kyary Pamyu Pamyu and Otoboke Beaver! The Music Way Project is a collaboration between the Culture and Entertainment Industry Promotion Association (CEIPA) and the Toyota Group, with an aim of bringing Japanese music overseas. After successful shows in the US and Thailand, the project is now coming to Europe for the first time with a one-off performance in London’s Outernet Live on Monday 14th December 2026. matsuri ’26 will take place at the Outernet Live, on the first floor of the Outernet building near Tottenham Court Road station in central London (WC2H 8LH). The show is scheduled to open its doors at 19:00, with the venue’s curfew at 23:00. The stage order for the three performers has not been announced. hitsujibungaku (羊文学) are an alternative rock band fronted by Moeka Shiozuka (Vocals, Guitar) and Yurika Kawanishi (Bass). The launch is accompanied by a new Mirror Maker YouTube channel focused on the creative process behind comics, writing, animation, games, and other narrative work. The channel will feature creator discussions, process-focused videos, and behind-the-scenes material from ongoing projects. items.title: [Interview] Le Chateau de Cagliostro : analyse du film par Jean-Christophe Perrier (2/3)
items.summary: Interview et portraits Japanime / Interviews et portraits Cinéma 0 [Interview] Le Chateau de Cagliostro : analyse du film par Jean-Christophe Perrier (2/3) par Marie jenck · Publié 11 novembre 2026 · Mis à jour 11 novembre 2026 Après avoir contextualisé le rapport de Jean-Christophe Perrier avec le premier long-métrage de Hayao Miyazaki et la promotion de ce film d’animation en Normandie, nous allons étudier en détail le travail du réalisateur sur ce long-métrage à l’époque où son nom commençait progressivement à se faire connaître. Nous allons aussi comprendre son sévère soucis du détail partagé avec Yasuo Otsuka, les différences entre ce Lupin édulcoré et celui bien plus vicieux du manga d’origine, en plus du rapport des enfants à l’animation. Une analyse qui vous plongera dans le contexte des années 70. Résumé du film : Lupin III , nommé dans le film Edgar de la Cambriole, se rend avec son comparse Jigen au royaume de Cagliostro. Leur braquage réussi en grande pompe leur ayant uniquement rapporté des faux-billets dont leur fabrication proviendrait de ce petit comté reculé. Sur le chemin, ils feront la rencontre d’une jeune femme en fuite et découvriront une chevalière pourvue d’un animal atypique. Ceux-ci éveilleront des souvenirs lointains chez le jeune voleur et le motiveront à sauver la demoiselle en détresse. Celle-ci étant retenue par le Comte de Cagliostro dans son imposant château. Aidé de ses camarades, Lupin devra contourner tous les pièges qu’il renferme et empêcher l’ignoble personnage d’épous

items.title: 'Mashle: Sanma Taisou Shinkakusha Saishuu Shiken-hen' Reveals Additional Cast, Promo
items.summary: The official website of the Mashle (Mashle: Magic and Muscles) television anime revealed additional cast pair, a key visual and a promotional video for its third season on Wednesday. The new season is scheduled to premiere on January 10 at 12.00 a.m. on Tokyo MX, BS11, Gunma TV and Tochigi TV, followed by Mainichi Broadcasting, Shizuoka Broadcasting, FBS Fukoka, Chukyo TV, Nagano Asahi, Okayama, Miyagi TV, Sapporo TV, Television Niigata and Chugoku. Voice actors Souma Saitou (Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e) and Ryouta Suzuki (Sakamoto Days) are joining the cast as Domina Blowlive and Lévis Rosequartz, respectively. Tomoya Tanaka (Engage Kiss) returns to direct the third season at A-1 Pictures. Yousuke Kuroda (Boku no Hero Academia) is handling series composition and penning the script. Chiaki Furuzumi (Ore dake Level Up na Ken sub-character design) is designing the characters with Satoshi Motoyama (Saigo ni Hitotsu dake Onegai shitemo Yoroshii deshou ka) serving as sound director. Mashle adapts Hajime Koumoto's action comedy manga, which ran in Weekly Shounen Jump from January 2020 to July 2023. Shueisha published the 18th and final volume in October 2023. VIZ Media simulpublished the manga in English and shipped the 18th and final volume in December 2024. Shueisha's Manga Plus platform also simulpublished the manga in English. PV 1 Source: Comic Nataile

Featuring an original story set after the events of BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , the mobile game launched on October 28 featuring new characters designed by series creator Tite Kubo, customizable Zanpakuto, and a card-based action battle system. With worldwide pre-registrations surpassing 1 million, we had the opportunity to speak with the game’s producers about its development, Tite Kubo’s involvement, feedback from the Closed Beta Test, and what players can expect at launch and beyond.
